digest.component_or_area: jira adapters value maps / jira-family boundary guard
propositions: The ticket-type map _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE is duplicated across the Cloud and DC create paths, unlike the status and priority maps which are single-sourced.
The boundary guard enforces exactly-one-literal for the status and priority maps but has no equivalent assertion for the ticket-type map.
Divergence between the two copies would silently map a local ticket type to different Jira issue types depending on deployment with no comparison catching it.

The map should be relocated to a single definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the historical _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias so outbound_fields._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE stays resolvable as a module attribute.
The boundary guard must be extended to the type map and mutation-checked so reintroducing a second literal fails the build.
The type mapping must be pinned by value for all four local types (task/story/bug/epic) through both the Cloud and DC create paths.
